quest.title: The Gourmet Supremos: On the Road
quest.description: Xudong, the self-proclaimed leader of the Gourmet Supremos, seems to have something he'd like some help with...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Mora x10000, Hero's Wit x3, Delicious Jewelry Soup x3

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Hey traveler! This way! I've been looking for you.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: We're the Gourmet Supremos. All-Star Gourmet!

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: As I said, who would remember such a silly name...

response.speaker: Julie
response.text: Really? I think it's quite memorable...

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: That's just because Xudong talks about it every day.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Hahaha, a good name is not easy to come by. Of course I have to keep repeating it.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What other names did you have before?

response.speaker: Julie
response.text: I came up with a lot of names, like "pika pika rice team" and "Gulu Gulu dessert team"!

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: I really don't understand why you Mondstadters like to make these ridiculous names, sweetee floweree, Calla Lilyyy, Wolfhook fruitee...

response.speaker: Julie
response.text: You can also call me Julie-Julie...

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: ...Julie, can you please act normal?

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Because these kinds of names are memorable. See, you remember it right away.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Haha... So Liyue's Jueyun Chilili must've been named by a Mondstadter, right?

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: No, that's totally different. This is simply to highlight the spiciness of the Jueyun Chilili. That's why we use the double "li". It makes perfect sense.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: That makes no sense! How does that highlight the spiciness of the Jueyun Chili?!

response.speaker: Julie
response.text: Well... I think it sounds cute...

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Hahaha, anyway, if it's memorable, it is a good name.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: All right, let's not talk about that. Traveler, we'd like to ask you a favor.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: We want to cook something special with the local ingredients of Inazuma.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: In order to ensure the freshness of the food, we are going to collect the ingredients in the forest north of the city.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: But... I heard there are many monsters over there, so I'd like to invite you to come with us. Other than the reward, we'll take care of your meals. What do you say? Would you like to help?

choices.text: What kind of ingredients do you want to collect?

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Let's decide when we get there. Making food with unknown ingredients is the principle of Gourmet Supremos.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: To put it bluntly, this guy never thinks about what kind of food he's going to make, or what kind of ingredients he's looking for. He just goes with the flow.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Hahaha, you're not wrong. But no matter what the ingredients are, I'll be able to cook something delicious.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Thank you, Traveler.

response.speaker: Julie
response.text: Me? I can deal with the monsters, but when I do that, sometimes I get so focused that I get into all kinds of trouble.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Meaning that when she's dealing with the monsters, she won't be able to deal with anything else except the monsters, until they drop dead.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Then this idiot would chase the monsters and follow them to all sorts of weird places. And when she kills them, she'll completely forget where she is and get lost in the end.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Her extreme focus is what makes Julie a great adventurer. But when she gets lost, it takes a long time to find her...

response.speaker: Julie
response.text: Well, there's a reason for it...

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Therefore, we'd like to ask you, a more self-restrained traveler, to help us deal with those monsters.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: That's right. We'll be counting on you, Traveler.

talks.objective: Go to the designated location to find cooking ingredients

dialogues.text: What can I do for you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Excuse me, you are...

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: I'm Kamei Munehisa, I am just passing by.

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Wow... This guy dresses like a samurai...

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: S...samurai? Is he the samurai from the Shogunate... I heard that the Shogunate's attitude towards outlanders is quite... subtle...

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: Don't worry. I've left the Shogunate. I'm no longer a samurai.

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: I often come here to look for food. But today, I noticed monsters wandering around.

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: They've taken all the food around here. So I had to destroy them.

choices.text: How often do you come here?

response.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
response.text: There are not many monsters around here usually. I often come here to pick fruits or hunt.

response.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
response.text: Well, that's all I have to say. After killing these monsters, the other ones around here won't dare to come here for a while.

response.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
response.text: If you are also looking for food, you can look around. I only took what I need. There should be something left.

response.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
response.text: Well, goodbye.

response.speaker: Julie
response.text: Did he just leave just like that? His behavior is exactly like the samurai I heard about before...

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: But what does he mean he's left the Shogunate? Samurai who have left the Shogunate are...

choices.text: They are like the enemies we met before.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Yes, I also heard that some samurai who have left the Shogunate wander around and rob people in the streets for a living...

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Although he doesn't look like a bad guy, we'd better stay vigilant.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: All right, all right. Aren't we here to look for ingredients? But judging from the current situation, we'd better not go any further, in case it gets dangerous.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: This traveler has been escorting us for such a long time. Let's cook something here, have a short break and then we'll head back to town.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: The guy said there are still ingredients left behind, right? Let's look around.

choices.text: Did you kill all these monsters?

response.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
response.text: Yes, they are just ordinary monsters. They're easy to deal with.

choices.text: Why are you looking for food in the wild?

response.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
response.text: I have my own reasons.

talks.objective: Explore further and find cooking ingredients

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: I was going to look for some fresh ingredients... Anyway, these will do.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: I'm sorry. I wanted to cook something nice for you, but now I guess we'll have to make do with these.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: You worked hard escorting us. "It's fine" is not an acceptable answer.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: I'll remember this and treat you to a nice meal next time.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Julie, is the soup ready? Remember not to let Parvaneh...

response.speaker: Julie
response.text: No, no, just let the soup simmer quietly!

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: It's fine. I'm seasoning this soup according to my improved recipe. I'm just adding a little bit of seasoning...

response.speaker: Julie
response.text: I don't understand your improved recipe. Stop it! Xudong, Xudong, come over here!

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Parvaneh! Hey! What kind of strange seasoning are you putting in!?

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Strange seasoning? This is my special sauce! This is the result of my thesis research!

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: I don't need that! Let's just eat something ordinary today! Julie, stop her!

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Humph, what do you know... Fine, let me fine-tune this. I am going to make the ultimate seasoning that will make any dish delicious.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Ultimate seasoning... Is something like that really possible?

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: No one has ever done it, that's why I am going to! I'll show those stuck-up unbelievers at the Akademiya!

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Haha... Well, I look forward to it.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: By the way, traveler, thank you for spending all this time running around with us. Thank you.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: I'll prepare a takeaway for you. You've got to have enough food when you are adventuring out there.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Next time we meet, I will treat you to a nice meal.

choices.text: I'll find you to cook me a feast next time.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Hahaha, okay. I'll make a note of this. I'll make sure to treat you to something nice next time...

talks.objective: Talk to the person in front of you
Find a good spot for cooking

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Oh! I think this is it. I heard that there are many fresh ingredients here. Look carefully.

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Why are we looking for ingredients in the forest here in Inazuma? I thought the specialty here is seafood...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: I heard people in Inazuma cook with Sakura Blooms. That sounds delicious.

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Shouldn't we go directly to the cherry trees...

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Come on. Let's keep looking up ahead.

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Those monsters... Have all been knocked down.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Those monsters are all lying on the ground. It's quite an impressive sight... Let's go and have a look.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: There is nothing we can use here... The vegetables are all rotten.

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Well, these fruits have not been stored properly. They're completely useless now.

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Well, there's some dried meat here. Can we cook with it?
